claims.text: Octreotide (somatostatin analog) for sus variceal bleed: IV bolus, then cont infusion.
claims.quote: Octreotide, a synthetic analog of somatostatin, is used in patients with suspected variceal bleeding. Octreotide is given as an IV bolus followed by a continuous infusion.

claims.text: Tranexamic acid ⍉recommended for GI bleeding outside a trial (HALT-IT: ⍉↓death).
claims.quote: tranexamic acid did not reduce death from gastrointestinal bleeding. On the basis of our results, tranexamic acid should not be used for the treatment of gastrointestinal bleeding outside the context of a randomised trial.
